description: Shell quoting for bash, PowerShell and cmd.exe with a parse-back check — Turns up to 50 literal strings into a safely quoted argument for bash/sh (POSIX single-quote method), PowerShell (single-quoted literal) and cmd.exe, for agents that build a command line from untrusted or free-form text, and parses each result back with a model of that shell's rules to prove it yields the original string. It returns `unsupported` for strings cmd.exe cannot carry safely (line break

targets.description: Shells to quote for; default all three. Status is unsupported when any requested target cannot carry a value.

values.description: Literal argument values; at most 100000 characters in total.

name: shell-quote
